title: Static Samurai
description: A mixed-media artwork featuring a horizontal comic strip of four sequential poses of a bald, muscular figure in a white gi performing dynamic martial arts movements with glowing energy effects around his hands. The strip is centered over large, bold black 3D text reading 'STATIC SAMURAI' against a vibrant hot pink impasto-painted background with visible texture.
prompt: A mixed media painting on a textured hot pink impasto background featuring a white rectangular panel containing four sequential comic-style panels. Inside each panel is the same bald muscular man in a white gi performing different fighting poses with glowing white and pink energy effects around his fists. Large bold black 3D letters spelling STATIC SAMURAI are positioned behind the white panel. Vibrant, graphic, comic book style with strong outlines.
medium: mixed media, acrylic on canvas with paper collage
